title: test_expiry_too_far: reject-probe seq is below the accept-probe seq, so a persist-on-reject regression stays invisible
description: Codereview finding (pass 3) on worker6-eaws: in lichen/tests/coap_slot_claim/src/main.c test_expiry_too_far, the EXPIRY_TOO_FAR rejection probe signs with seq 1 and the boundary-accept with seq 2. The module convention (see test_gates NO_CLOCK case, seq 7 above the later seq-5 accept) is to sign the rejection probe with a seq ABOVE the accept so that any regression moving the cap check below lichen_slot_claim_seq_commit (persisting the high-water on a rejected claim) makes the accept fail loudly. Fix: reject probe seq 2, accept probe seq 1 (or follow the 7/5 pattern). Add the same explanatory comment the NO_CLOCK case carries. Files: lichen/tests/coap_slot_claim/src/main.c.
close_reason: Fixed: test_expiry_too_far now signs the rejection probe with seq 2 and the boundary-accept with seq 1 (house pattern from the NO_CLOCK probe), with explanatory comment, so a persist-on-reject regression flips the accept to REPLAY. Host test 152/152.
